code.finding: 5 Gauges (DB-polled every 30s), 8 Counters (event-driven), and 5 Histograms (HTTP, IPFS/IPNS general, republish batch, IPNS resolve, IPNS publish) — all alert thresholds for Phase 26 should reference these existing histograms

Most comprehensive retry pattern in the codebase: 3 attempts, 1s base delay, 30s max delay, exponential backoff, respects Retry-After header for 429s, falls back to primary→fallback endpoint, 10s per-request timeout
MAX_RETRIES=3, RETRY_BASE_DELAY=1000ms with exponential backoff; skips retry if error message is 'Upload cancelled by user'
Uses a shared promise for concurrent 401 refresh handlers — all concurrent 401 errors await the same refresh promise to prevent duplicate token refresh calls
Performance mark format is cipherbox:<operation>:<id>:start → cipherbox:<operation>:<id>:end; outputs to browser Performance API (DevTools Performance tab)

workflow: Codebase scout agent can be launched in background while the orchestrator handles git branch creation in parallel
The researcher agent commits its own output file — the orchestrator should not attempt a second commit of the same file
Feature branch should be created early in discuss-phase (before presenting gray areas) so all context writes land on the correct branch
GSD auto-advance chain: discuss-phase → plan-phase → execute-phase can run at the same nesting level via Skill tool to avoid deep agent nesting freezes
